```{r, message = FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(car)
library(bestglm)
library(keras3)
```

```{r}
infections <- read_excel("Infections.xlsx")
infections$date <- as.Date(infections$date)
```

```{r}
infections$day <- as.numeric(infections$date - as.Date("2019-11-30"))
infections$fog <- as.factor(infections$fog)
infections$thunder <- as.factor(infections$thunder)
infections$dust <- as.factor(infections$dust)
infections$smoke <- as.factor(infections$smoke)
infections$estpos <- ifelse(infections$posencounters == 0, 0, (infections$restests / infections$restests) * infections$encounters)
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
reduced <- infections[,c(2:23, 32, 33)]
names(reduced)[names(reduced) == "estpos"] <- "y"
best <- bestglm(as.data.frame(na.omit(reduced)), IC = "CV", method = "exhaustive")
```

```{r}
summary(best$BestModel)
```

```{r}
vif(best$BestModel)
```

```{r}
stepwise <- step(lm(estpos ~ ., data = na.omit(infections[, c(2:23, 32, 33)])), direction = "both")
summary(stepwise)
```

```{r}
vif(stepwise)
```

```{r}
reduced <- lm(estpos ~ evap + otemp + dir5 + maxwind2 + fog + co + o3 + pm10 + so2 + day, data = infections)
summary(reduced)
```

```{r}
subinfect <- as.data.frame(na.omit(infections[, c(3, 8, 10, 12, 13, 17, 19, 20, 22, 32, 33)]))
names(subinfect)[names(subinfect) == "estpos"] <- "y"
```

```{r}
bestglm(subinfect)$Subsets[5,]
```
otemp, co, pm10, day

```{r}
subinfect2 <- as.data.frame(na.omit(infections[, c(2:4, 8, 10, 12:23, 32, 33)]))
names(subinfect2)[names(subinfect2) == "estpos"] <- "y"
```

```{r}
bestglm(subinfect2)$Subsets[5,]
```

```{r}
normalize <- function(x) (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE))

normalized <- na.omit(as.data.frame(lapply(infections[, c(8, 17, 20, 32, 33)], normalize)))
```

```{r}
samples <- nrow(normalized) - 120 - 10 + 1
x <- array(NA, dim = c(samples, 120, 4))
y <- rep(NA, samples)

for (i in 1:samples) {
  x[i,,] <- as.matrix(normalized[i:(i + 119), c(1:4)])
  y[i] <- normalized[i + 120 + 10 - 1, 5]
}
```

```{r}
x_train <- x[1:(samples - 30),,]
y_train <- y[1:(samples - 30)]

x_test <- x[(samples - 29):samples,,]
y_test <- y[(samples - 29):samples]
```

```{r}
model <- keras_model_sequential() %>%
  layer_lstm(units = 64, activation = "sigmoid", input_shape = c(120, 4)) %>%
  layer_dropout(rate = 0.1) %>%
  layer_dense(units = 1)

model %>% compile(
  loss = "mean_squared_error",
  optimizer = optimizer_adam()
)
```

```{r}
model %>% fit(
  x_train, y_train,
  epochs = 100,
  batch_size = 5,
  validation_split = 0.2
)
```

```{r}
model %>% evaluate(x_test, y_test)
```

```{r}
pred_train <- model %>% predict(x_train)
pred_test <- model %>% predict(x_test)

pred <- c(pred_train, pred_test)
actual <- c(y_train, y_test)
```

```{r}
plot(actual, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 1,
     ylab = "Normalized Infection Count", xlab = "Day",
     main = "Actual vs. Predicted Normalized Infection Count")

lines(pred, col = "red", lwd = 1)

test_start <- length(y_train)
test_end <- length(actual)

rect(xleft = test_start, xright = test_end,
     ybottom = par("usr")[3], ytop = par("usr")[4],
     col = rgb(1, 1, 0, 0.5), border = NA)

legend("topright", legend = c("Actual", "Predicted"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = c(2, 2))
```

```{r}
reduced <- na.omit(infections[, c(3, 8, 10, 12, 13, 17, 19, 20, 22, 32, 33)])
normalized <- as.data.frame(lapply(reduced[, c(1:4, 6:11)], normalize))
normalized$fog <- as.numeric(reduced$fog)
```

```{r}
samples <- nrow(normalized) - 120 - 10 + 1
x <- array(NA, dim = c(samples, 120, 10))
y <- rep(NA, samples)

for (i in 1:samples) {
  x[i,,] <- as.matrix(normalized[i:(i + 119), c(1:9, 11)])
  y[i] <- normalized[i + 120 + 10 - 1, 10]
}
```

```{r}
x_train <- x[1:(samples - 30),,]
y_train <- y[1:(samples - 30)]

x_test <- x[(samples - 29):samples,,]
y_test <- y[(samples - 29):samples]
```

```{r}
model <- keras_model_sequential() %>%
  layer_lstm(units = 64, activation = "sigmoid", input_shape = c(120, 10)) %>%
  layer_dropout(rate = 0.1) %>%
  layer_dense(units = 1)

model %>% compile(
  loss = "mean_squared_error",
  optimizer = optimizer_adam()
)
```

```{r}
model %>% fit(
  x_train, y_train,
  epochs = 100,
  batch_size = 5,
  validation_split = 0.2
)
```

```{r}
model %>% evaluate(x_test, y_test)
```

```{r}
pred_train <- model %>% predict(x_train)
pred_test <- model %>% predict(x_test)

pred <- c(pred_train, pred_test)
actual <- c(y_train, y_test)
```

```{r}
plot(actual, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 1,
     ylab = "Normalized Infection Count", xlab = "Day",
     main = "Actual vs. Predicted Normalized Infection Count")

lines(pred, col = "red", lwd = 1)

test_start <- length(y_train)
test_end <- length(actual)

rect(xleft = test_start, xright = test_end,
     ybottom = par("usr")[3], ytop = par("usr")[4],
     col = rgb(1, 1, 0, 0.5), border = NA)

legend("topright", legend = c("Actual", "Predicted"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = c(2, 2))
```

```{r}
reduced <- na.omit(infections[, c(3, 8, 10, 12, 13, 17, 19, 20, 22, 32, 33)])
normalized <- as.data.frame(lapply(reduced[, c(1:4, 6:11)], normalize))
normalized$fog <- as.numeric(reduced$fog)
```
